english_title: Example 1.2.2: Divergence of the Harmonic Sequence
statement_en: Define the harmonic sequence $$H_n:=\sum_{k\leq n}\frac{1}{k}.$$ Prove that this sequence diverges.

attempts.first_error_msg: failed to compile definition, consider marking it as 'noncomputable' because it depends on 'Real.instDivInvMonoid', which is 'noncomputable'

import Mathlib

open Filter

noncomputable def harmonicSeq (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Finset.sum (Finset.Icc 1 n) fun k => (1 : ℝ) / (k : ℝ)

theorem harmonic_sequence_diverges :
    ¬ ∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto harmonicSeq atTop (nhds l) := by
  sorry
